$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0125-transfer-chain.xml, transcribed element by element from the XML bytes - NOT produced by e142DocumentToJson (Rule 10, D-030). The E142-0225 Figure R2-22 lifecycle: wafer -> tape -> target. Covers: TransferMap maxOccurs="unbounded", so the TARGET carries TWO of them because the source is named per MAP and not per transfer; the child element is T, NOT Transfer - the TYPE is TransferType and the standard's figures label the arrows Transfer(...), which is the trap that makes a reader find an empty map instead of failing; all three From* are use="required" and form an intra-document keyref onto a SubstrateMap, which is why the two source substrates are declared and are not decoration; each END of a transfer is addressed independently - the first map is Transfer(FX,FY,TID), coordinates in and IDENTIFIER out, the second is Transfer(FID,TX,TY), identifier in and COORDINATES out; and two SubstrateMaps carry NO Overlay at all, which is legal because Overlay is minOccurs="0".
